## Description (first paragraph)

Cite the lattice nodes that informed a Wire EDM prediction (Ra, wire-break,
recast). Every explanation names ≥ 1 real `WEDM_LATTICE_GRAPH.json` node by
ID, describes the evidence that ties the query to that node (same material,
adjacent thickness, shared wire, etc.), and surfaces the similarity score.
